roadmap.title: First farm: planting and building
roadmap.description: Plant a first crop, tree, flower, animal and pond; place the first production building, feeder, sprinkler, sign and quick travel post; open photo mode and customise the farmer, tractor and fairy.

roadmap.title: Town shops, quests and errands
roadmap.description: Open the first town shops, the Garage and Fuel Depot, finish quests and townsfolk errands, build the house and the first house jobs.

roadmap.title: Mid-game growth
roadmap.description: Climb farm and player levels, expand land, terraform, hire farmhands, enter the mine and level items.

roadmap.title: Item levels and counters
roadmap.description: Raise item levels to 50, build up harvest, plow and tractor counters, and finish the shop upgrade series.

roadmap.title: Late-game grind and prestige
roadmap.description: Finish the large harvest totals, money, level 200-300, land expansions, prestige and the remaining one-off builds.

achievements.displayName: It is the first step that costs

steps.text: Keep harvesting and finishing quests until the farm level at the top right of the screen reads 10.

achievements.displayName: Hard work pays off

steps.text: Keep harvesting and finishing quests until your farm level reaches 50.

achievements.displayName: Time flies when you're having fun

steps.text: Keep harvesting and finishing quests until your farm level reaches 100.

achievements.displayName: Give credit where credit is due

steps.text: Fill as much of your farm as you can with @item{Brussels Sprouts} and harvest it again and again.
Each harvest gives 235 xp, or 470 xp during a boost.

achievements.displayName: Fake it till you make it

steps.text: Raise your farm level. Player level, shown beside your avatar at the top left, rises along with it.

achievements.displayName: Fall seven times, stand up eight

steps.text: Keep raising your farm level until your player level reaches 20.

achievements.displayName: Hard work never did anyone any harm

steps.text: Keep raising your farm level until your player level reaches 50.

achievements.displayName: No place like home
achievements.summary: Enter a house on your farm.

steps.text: Place a house on your farm. It finishes in 4 stages, one hour apart.
When all 4 stages are done, enter the house.

achievements.displayName: A watched pot never boils

steps.text: In your house, turn one room into a kitchen and place a stove in it.
Cook any recipe until it finishes.

achievements.displayName: Piece of cake
achievements.description: Reach level 10 in a food recipe
achievements.summary: Bring one food recipe up to level 10.

steps.text: Cook the same recipe again and again until it reaches level 10.

achievements.displayName: Every picture tells a story

steps.text: Buy an easel from the house shop (Q) and place it in your house.
Paint any picture until it is finished.

achievements.displayName: Master of the trade

steps.text: Paint the same picture again and again until it reaches level 10.

achievements.displayName: The sincerest form of flattery

steps.text: Buy a piano from the house shop (Q) and place it in your house.
Make a tune at the piano by completing all of its steps.

achievements.displayName: Practice makes perfect

steps.text: Make the same song again and again at the piano until it reaches level 10.

achievements.displayName: It is better to give than to receive

guide.context: Earn favor by helping, and do not count on the 2 favor points you receive each day.

steps.text: Reach player level 3, when the favor meter starts to appear.
Help other players on their farms, or complete townsfolk errands, until you have earned 25 favor points.

achievements.displayName: One good turn deserves another

guide.context: Your favor meter holds your player level divided by 4, plus 25, and can overflow by 1,000. Spending favor makes room for more.

steps.text: Keep helping other players on their farms and doing townsfolk errands.
Build the @loc{Collaboration Hub} in town (farm level 5, 3 ribbons), then spend favor there whenever the meter is full. Keep going until 2,500 favor points are earned in total.

achievements.displayName: As green as a gourd

steps.text: Plow a tile with left click, then open the shop (Q) and plant a crop, such as lettuce, on it.

achievements.displayName: The apple never falls far from the tree

steps.text: Open the shop (Q), buy a tree, such as an apple tree, and plant it.

achievements.displayName: Don't put all your eggs in one basket

steps.text: Open the shop (Q) and buy any animal. A @item{Leghorn Chicken} costs the least.

achievements.displayName: Bigger fish to fry

steps.text: Open the shop (Q), buy a fish, such as a clownfish, and place its tile.

achievements.displayName: No garden without its weeds

steps.text: Open the shop (Q), buy a flower, such as a rose, and plant it.

achievements.displayName: All good things come to him who waits
achievements.description: Harvest any crop or flower that takes a day or more to grow
achievements.summary: Harvest a crop or flower with a growth time of at least one day.

guide.context: Growth times are real time, so plant it and come back later.

steps.text: Plant @item{Pumpkin} or @item{Common Spinach}, which take 1 day. Other choices: @item{Red Spinach}, @item{Acorn Pumpkin}, @item{Brussels Sprouts}, @item{Baby Boo Pumpkin}, or a carnation or poinsettia.
When it has finished growing, harvest it.

achievements.displayName: All hat and no cattle
achievements.summary: Reach level 50 with any one animal.

steps.text: Buy a @item{Leghorn Chicken}, the cheapest animal.
Harvest it again and again until it reaches level 50.

achievements.displayName: Make hay while the sun shines
achievements.summary: Reach level 50 with any one crop.

guide.context: Any crop works. @item{Brussels Sprouts} gives the most xp and coins and can be planted in any season, but it takes 48 real hours to grow and costs a lot on a small farm.

steps.text: Pick one crop and plant it.
Harvest and replant that same crop again and again until it reaches level 50.

achievements.displayName: Sleep like a log
achievements.summary: Reach level 50 with any one tree.

steps.text: Pick one tree, such as an apple tree, and plant it.
Harvest it again and again until it reaches level 50.

achievements.displayName: Still waters run deep
achievements.summary: Reach level 50 with any one pond.

steps.text: Buy a clownfish pond. @item{Ebony Clownfish} and @item{Amber Clownfish} work the same way.
Harvest it again and again until it reaches level 50.

achievements.displayName: As welcome as flowers in May
achievements.summary: Reach level 50 with any one flower.

steps.text: Pick one flower and plant it.
Harvest it again and again until it reaches level 50.

achievements.displayName: Easy does it
achievements.description: Reach level 30 or more of 40 different items
achievements.summary: Reach level 30 or higher with 40 different items.

steps.text: Plant and harvest many different crops, trees, flowers, animals and fish until 40 of them are at level 30.

achievements.displayName: Easier said than done
achievements.description: Reach level 50 or more of 50 different items
achievements.summary: Reach level 50 or higher with 50 different items.

steps.text: Keep harvesting your different crops, trees, flowers, animals and fish until 50 of them are at level 50.

achievements.displayName: You want a thing well done, do it yourself
achievements.summary: Reach level 100 with any one item.

steps.text: Pick one item, such as a tree, and harvest it again and again until it reaches level 100.

achievements.displayName: If wealth is lost, nothing is lost
achievements.description: Build your first shop in town
achievements.summary: Build your first shop in town.

steps.text: Press M to open the map, then Z to travel to town.
Click a blue shop-shaped board on a wall and place a shop. The @loc{Vegetable Shop} costs 1000 coins and is open from the start.

achievements.displayName: If you pay peanuts, you get monkeys
achievements.description: Upgrade any shop to level 10 or more
achievements.summary: Upgrade any one shop to level 10.

guide.context: An upgrade needs money plus a harvested item. If it needs more of that item than you can store, upgrade the @loc{Warehouse} or the shop that deals with that item.

steps.text: Click a shop you have built and press upgrade to see what the next level needs.
Collect those items and upgrade again and again until the shop is level 10.

achievements.displayName: In for a penny, in for a pound
achievements.description: Upgrade any shop to level 50 or more
achievements.summary: Upgrade any one shop to level 50.

steps.text: Build the @loc{Garage} (farm level 2, 1 ribbon) or the @loc{Warehouse} (farm level 12, 5 ribbons).
Upgrade that shop again and again until it reaches level 50.

achievements.displayName: A stitch in time saves nine
achievements.description: Upgrade the warehouse to level 25 or more

steps.text: Build the @loc{Warehouse} in town. It opens at farm level 12 and costs 5 ribbons.
Upgrade it until it reaches level 25.

achievements.displayName: Failing to plan is planning to fail

steps.text: Reach farm level 5.
Click a boundary wall of your farm to see its level and cost, then buy the expansion.

achievements.displayName: Many a little makes a mickle

steps.text: Buy each new plot as it opens. A new one opens every 4 farm levels, starting at level 5.

achievements.displayName: Well done is better than well said

guide.context: You start with 1 plot, so 48 more are needed. The 49th opens at farm level 193.

steps.text: Buy each new plot as it opens, every 4 farm levels, until you own 49.

achievements.displayName: It takes two to tango
achievements.description: Join the farm of another player

steps.text: From the main menu, choose @mechanic{Join Farm}.
Click any game in the list of online farms to join it.

achievements.displayName: Hit the nail on the head

steps.text: Open the shop (Q), go to the Buildings tab and place any production building, such as a @item{Beehive}, @item{Windmill} or @item{Silo}.

achievements.displayName: You get more flies with honey
achievements.description: Reach level 10 or more of any production building
achievements.summary: Reach level 10 with any production building.

steps.text: Use one production building again and again until it reaches level 10.

achievements.displayName: Picture-Perfect

steps.text: Press Esc and click @mechanic{Photo Mode}.

achievements.displayName: Never do things by halves

steps.text: Harvest any mix of crops, herbs, trees, flowers, animals and fish until the total reaches 10,000.

achievements.displayName: Everything is good in its season

steps.text: Keep harvesting any mix of crops, herbs, trees, flowers, animals and fish until the total reaches 50,000.

achievements.displayName: To travel is a better thing than to arrive

steps.text: Open the shop (Q), go to the Buildings tab and place a @item{Quick Travel Post}. It costs 4 ribbons.

achievements.displayName: No song, no supper

steps.text: Open the shop (Q), go to the Buildings tab and buy a @item{Feeder}, @item{Hen Feeder} or @item{Livestock Feeder}. It costs 4 ribbons.
Place it next to your animal tiles.

achievements.displayName: When it rains it pours

steps.text: Open the shop (Q), go to the Buildings tab and buy a @item{Sprinkler}. It costs 2 ribbons.
Place it on flowers or plowed land. It waters the 9 tiles in a 3 x 3 area.

achievements.displayName: Money does not grow on trees
achievements.description: Have 1 million coins in your farm at any given time
achievements.summary: Have 1 million coins on your farm at one time.

steps.text: Keep harvesting and selling, and save your coins until you hold 1 million at once.

achievements.displayName: Another day, another dollar
achievements.description: Have 100 million coins in your farm at any given time
achievements.summary: Have 100 million coins on your farm at one time.

guide.context: Prestiging items to level 500 (prestige 5) costs a lot but raises the coins from each harvest.

steps.text: Fill as much of your farm as you can with @item{Brussels Sprouts} and harvest it again and again.
Spend favor points during harvests to raise the coins from each one.

achievements.displayName: Business before pleasure

steps.text: Finish quests and townsfolk errands, which pay medals.

Build the @loc{Restaurant} (farm level 22) and hand in 150 spices for 6 medals each time. Spices come from @item{Clove}, @item{Cassia Cinnamon}, @item{Ceylon Cinnamon} and cocoa trees, and from @item{Coriander}, parsley and peppercorn plants.
The @loc{Money Exchange} (farm level 75) also trades money for medals.

achievements.displayName: No pain, no gain

steps.text: Reach farm level 40 and build the @loc{Farmhands Union} in town. It costs 50 ribbons.
Open the shop (Q), go to the Buildings tab and place a @item{Farmhand Stall}. It costs 10 ribbons.

achievements.displayName: Good counsel does no harm

steps.text: Open the shop (Q), go to the Buildings tab and place a @item{Sign with Arrow} (5 ribbons) or a @item{Billboard with Arrows} (8 ribbons).

achievements.displayName: Appearances can be deceptive

steps.text: Enter your house and open the shop (Q) there.
Buy decorations until you have bought 25.

achievements.displayName: It's the squeaky wheel that gets the grease

steps.text: Drive the tractor to plow, plant or harvest. Any item type counts, so keep going until you reach 500,000 tiles.

achievements.displayName: Don't judge a book by its cover
achievements.description: Build a total of 1,000 decorations, roads or fences
achievements.summary: Place 1,000 decorations, roads or fences in total.

steps.text: Place decorations, roads or fences on your farm until you have built 1,000 in total.

achievements.displayName: Everyone has their price
achievements.summary: Build the Farmhands Union in town.

steps.text: Reach farm level 40.
Travel to town and place the @loc{Farmhands Union}.
steps.note: It costs 50 ribbons.

achievements.displayName: There is no such thing as bad publicity
achievements.summary: Build the Quest Bazaar in town.

steps.text: Reach farm level 62.
Travel to town and place the @loc{Quest Bazaar}.
steps.note: It costs 75 ribbons.

achievements.displayName: Beauty is only skin deep
achievements.summary: Change any customization option for your farmer and confirm it.

steps.text: Open the main menu, choose @mechanic{Customize}, then @mechanic{Character}, and change any option.
Press Esc to go back and answer Yes when the game asks you to confirm.

achievements.displayName: Easy rider
achievements.summary: Change any customization option for your tractor and confirm it.

steps.text: Open the main menu, choose @mechanic{Customize}, then @mechanic{Tractor}, and change any option.
Press Esc to go back and answer Yes when the game asks you to confirm.

achievements.displayName: The world is made of faith, trust, and pixie dust
achievements.summary: Change any customization option for your fairy and confirm it.

steps.text: Open the main menu, choose @mechanic{Customize}, then @mechanic{Fairy}, and change any option.
Press Esc to go back and answer Yes when the game asks you to confirm.

achievements.displayName: Fair exchange is no robbery
achievements.summary: Use the Money Exchange shop to convert one currency into another.

steps.text: Reach farm level 75.
Travel to town and place the @loc{Money Exchange}.
steps.note: It costs 50 ribbons.

steps.text: Open the shop and make any exchange.

achievements.displayName: To eat the fruit you must climb the tree

steps.text: Plant and harvest trees on your farm until the total reaches 25,000.

achievements.displayName: He who plants a garden plants happiness

steps.text: Plant and harvest crops on your farm until the total reaches 25,000.

achievements.displayName: Who goes barefoot must not plant thorns

steps.text: Plant and harvest flowers on your farm until the total reaches 25,000.

achievements.displayName: Never fry a fish till it's caught

guide.context: The count is pond tiles, not fish caught. A pond larger than 36 tiles gives fewer fish than tiles.

steps.text: Harvest your ponds until the total reaches 25,000 tiles.
steps.note: Keep each pond at 36 tiles or fewer to avoid the fish penalty.

achievements.displayName: It is a good horse that never stumbles

steps.text: Plant and harvest animals on your farm until the total reaches 25,000.

achievements.displayName: If it ain't broke, don't fix it

steps.text: Press M, then Z to travel to town.
Open a shop board and place the @loc{Garage}.
steps.note: It costs 1 ribbon and needs farm level 2.

achievements.displayName: Talk is cheap

steps.text: Press M, then Z to travel to town.
Talk to a townsperson and finish what they ask, such as handing over an item.

achievements.displayName: Nothing ventured, nothing gained

steps.text: Finish townsfolk errands in town until you have done 50.
steps.note: New errands appear after the day changes. Quit and restart the game after the day changes to get a fresh set.

achievements.displayName: Faith will move mountains
achievements.description: Perform a terraform action for the first time
achievements.summary: Make your first terraform change to the land.

steps.text: Reach farm level 24, travel to town and place the @loc{Landscaping Agency}.
steps.note: It costs 20 ribbons.

steps.text: Back on the farm, press Q, open the @mechanic{Terrain} tab and pick a terrain type to bring up the drone.
Stand at matching land, press Z to raise, lower or flatten, and confirm one change.
steps.note: Each successful change costs 10 diamonds.

achievements.displayName: No stone unturned

steps.text: Raise, lower or flatten land 100 times in total.
steps.note: At 10 diamonds each, plan for 1,000 diamonds.

achievements.displayName: Fortune favours the bold

steps.text: Press Esc and open @mechanic{Quest Log}.
Select a quest and click @mechanic{Discard} (Z) under its description, then confirm.

achievements.displayName: Haste makes waste
achievements.summary: Build a Fuel Depot on your farm.

steps.text: Press Q and open the @mechanic{Buildings} tab.
Place a @item{Fuel Depot} anywhere on your farm.
steps.note: It costs 4 ribbons.

achievements.displayName: Honesty is the best policy

steps.text: Press Esc, open @mechanic{Quest Log}, and read your first quest.
Do what the quest asks and finish it.

achievements.displayName: Do as you would be done by

steps.text: Keep finishing quests from the quest log until you have done 10.

achievements.displayName: Deeds, not words

steps.text: Keep finishing quests until you have done 50.

achievements.displayName: All is well that ends well
achievements.description: Finish an errand of a seasonal event
achievements.summary: Finish one errand of a seasonal event.

guide.context: Events only run for a limited time and come back every year.

steps.text: While a seasonal event is running, open its errands and finish any one of them.
steps.note: Most errands ask you to gather an event crop or item a set number of times.

achievements.displayName: If a job is worth doing, it is worth doing well
achievements.description: Unlock all rewards of a seasonal event
achievements.summary: Unlock every reward of one seasonal event.

guide.context: Each event runs for a limited time, usually 14 days. Daily errands refresh every day and unique errands can be done once, so spread them over the days.

steps.text: During a seasonal event, finish its daily and unique errands to earn stars.
Keep going until you unlock every reward on that event's reward track.

achievements.displayName: The only way to find a friend is to be one
achievements.summary: Sign the guestbook on another player's farm.

steps.text: Join another player's farm from @mechanic{Join Farm} in the main menu.
Open their guestbook, click @mechanic{Sign}, and choose any line.

achievements.displayName: No gardening mistakes, only experiments

steps.text: Drive the tractor over your land to plow, and keep going until you reach 100,000 tiles.
steps.note: Keep plowing while you plant and harvest.

achievements.displayName: A real diamond never loses its shine

steps.text: Reach farm level 80 and place a @item{Mine} from the @mechanic{Buildings} tab.
Click the mine to go in.

achievements.displayName: Two heads are better than one
achievements.description: Unlock new land for your farm in the Town Hall
achievements.summary: Buy one extra farm area at the Town Hall.

steps.text: Reach farm level 100 and place the @loc{Town Hall} in town.
steps.note: It costs 1,000,000 coins.

steps.text: Open the Town Hall and buy one of the new areas.

achievements.displayName: Creativity is contagious

steps.text: Keep making the same carving again and again until it reaches level 10.

achievements.displayName: Every block of stone has a statue inside it
achievements.summary: Finish a carving in your house and collect it.

steps.text: Build a house and place a workbench in it.
steps.note: A house takes 4 build steps, 1 hour apart.

steps.text: Start a carving at the workbench and, when it is done, collect it.

achievements.displayName: A blessing in disguise
achievements.description: Prestige an item in the Academy
achievements.summary: Prestige an item at the Farming Academy.

guide.context: Prestige resets the item to level 1. Do it as soon as the item reaches level 100, because extra levels are lost.

steps.text: Reach farm level 150 and place the @loc{Farming Academy} in town.
steps.note: It costs 125 ribbons.

steps.text: Take any item that is level 100 or higher to the Academy and prestige it.

achievements.displayName: The journey is more important than the destination
achievements.summary: Ride a train on your farm.

steps.text: Press Q and place a rail station and a fairly long stretch of rail track.
Click the station, then ride the train that appears.

achievements.displayName: Dogs have masters, cats have staff
achievements.summary: Pet your pet with an emote.

steps.text: Open the main menu, choose @mechanic{Customize}, then @mechanic{Emotes}, and set an emote on hotkey 1 to 4.
In the game, stand very close to your cat or dog and press that hotkey.

achievements.displayName: It's Kevin!
achievements.summary: Build a giant rubber duck on your farm.

steps.text: Press Q, find the giant rubber duck in the shop and place it anywhere on your farm.

achievements.displayName: If you have a hammer, all problems are nails
achievements.summary: Build the Carpenter's Shop in town.

steps.text: Reach farm level 45.
Travel to town and place the @loc{Carpenter's Shop}.
steps.note: It costs 25 ribbons.

achievements.displayName: Trust, but verify
achievements.summary: Build the Data Analyst in town.

steps.text: Reach farm level 25.
Travel to town and place the @loc{Data Analyst}.
steps.note: It costs 8 ribbons.

achievements.displayName: Put your best foot forward
achievements.summary: Build a golden decoration on your farm.

steps.text: Press Q and look for a golden decoration, such as the guestbook.
Place a new golden item on your farm.
steps.note: It must be new, placed on the farm and not in town, and not a replacement of an existing one.

achievements.displayName: You can have too much of a good thing

steps.text: Reach farm level 150.
Raise the Spanish Peanut crop to level 80.

achievements.displayName: Unity is strength
achievements.description: Upgrade the Farmhands Union to level 20
achievements.summary: Raise the Farmhands Union to level 20.

steps.text: Open the @loc{Farmhands Union} in town and press the upgrade button to see what the next level needs.
Pay each level's cost until the Union reaches level 20.
steps.note: Some levels ask for a harvest item in a large amount. If your stock is too small, upgrade the shop that stores it, or the @loc{Warehouse}.

achievements.displayName: One who hesitates is lost

steps.text: Harvest crops and other items on your farm, because tickets drop during harvest.
Keep harvesting until you have picked up 100 tickets.
steps.note: Upgrading the @loc{Ticket Trader} raises the drop rate.

achievements.displayName: If it's free, you're the product
achievements.description: Exchange Tickets for the first time
achievements.summary: Exchange Tickets at the Ticket Trader for the first time.

steps.text: Reach farm level 55.
Travel to town and place the @loc{Ticket Trader}.
steps.note: It costs 30 ribbons.

steps.text: Collect at least 4 tickets, open the shop and make an exchange.

achievements.displayName: Freedom lies in being bold
achievements.summary: Enter the code FR3D0M in the Join Farm menu.

steps.text: In the main menu open @mechanic{Join Farm}.
Press Z or click @mechanic{Use Code}, enter fr3d0m and click OK.
steps.note: Animal Freedom then appears under Game Settings.

achievements.displayName: Look before you leap
achievements.description: Build a Flag on the highest spot possible
achievements.summary: Place a flag on the highest terraformed point of your land.

steps.text: Pick a flat area at least 11 tiles wide in each direction and place tiles around it as a border to measure.
Terraform a pyramid of five raised levels above the ground, with widths of 3, 5, 7, 9 and 11 tiles.
steps.note: The lowest raised level is 11 wide and the top level is 3 wide.

steps.text: Buy a fresh @item{Flag} in the shop and set it on the top level.
steps.note: Use a flag you have just bought, not one you already own.

achievements.displayName: A rolling stone gathers no moss

steps.text: Mine one type of ore or gemstone again and again until it reaches level 50.
steps.note: The prospecting table lets you pay to raise one mineral's spawn chance.

achievements.displayName: When the going gets tough, the tough get going

steps.text: Fill as much of your farm as you can with @item{Brussels Sprouts} and harvest it again and again.
Each harvest gives 235 xp, or 470 xp during a boost.

achievements.displayName: When life gives you lemons, make lemonade
achievements.summary: Raise 10 different town shops to level 50.

guide.context: The Farmhands Union stops at level 25, so it cannot be one of the 10.

steps.text: Upgrade shops one at a time to level 50 until 10 of them have reached it.
steps.note: Shops that cannot reach level 50 do not count.

steps.text: Upgrade the @loc{Warehouse} to raise your storage when an upgrade asks for more than you can hold.

achievements.displayName: Wherever you go, there you are
achievements.description: Have 20 Quick Travel points in your farm
achievements.summary: Have 20 quick travel posts on your farm at the same time.

steps.text: Place @item{Quick Travel Post}s until you have 20. Removing one gives back half its value.

achievements.displayName: Good fences make good neighbours
achievements.description: Build a total of 5,000 decorations, roads or fences
achievements.summary: Place 5,000 decorations, roads or fences in total.

steps.text: Keep placing decorations, roads or fences until you have built 5,000 in total.

achievements.displayName: An army marches on its stomach
achievements.description: Reach level 50 in any house job
achievements.summary: Get any one house job to level 50.

steps.text: Pick one house job (food, painting, song or carving) and repeat it until it reaches level 50.

achievements.displayName: All cats are grey in the dark

steps.text: Enter the mine and click a locked area.
Pay the cost to unlock it, and repeat until you have unlocked 5 areas.
steps.note: Each new area costs more than the last.

achievements.displayName: Sticks in a bundle are unbreakable

steps.text: Choose a mushroom area in the mine, plant a mushroom with an 8-season growth, and harvest it.
Plant and harvest that same mushroom again and again until it reaches level 50.
steps.note: A patch frees up after several pickups, so you can plant there again.

achievements.displayName: Handsome is as handsome does

steps.text: Keep finishing quests until you have done 500.
After you build the @loc{Quest Bazaar}, take its extra quests to speed this up.

achievements.displayName: Weeds are flowers too, once you get to know them

steps.text: Reach farm level 60 so the herb tab appears in the shop.
Press Q, open the herb tab and plant any herb.
steps.note: Herbs can be planted in any season but harvested only in certain ones.

achievements.displayName: Friends of the physician, Pride of cooks

steps.text: Plant and harvest one herb again and again until it reaches level 50.
steps.note: The @loc{Apothecary} (farm level 60, 25 ribbons) buys herbs.

achievements.displayName: To plant a garden is to believe in tomorrow
achievements.description: Prestige 50 different items in the Academy (all on the same farm)
achievements.summary: Prestige 50 different items at the Farming Academy, all on the same farm.

steps.text: Bring items that have reached level 100 on one farm to the @loc{Farming Academy} and prestige them.
Keep going until 50 different items on that farm have been prestiged.

achievements.displayName: A garden is not a place, it’s a journey
achievements.description: Reach Prestige level 5 for 5 items in your farm
achievements.summary: Reach Prestige level 5 on 5 items on your farm.

steps.text: Pick 5 items, for example from the 50 you prestige for the other achievement.
Prestige each one again and again until all 5 have Prestige level 5.
steps.note: Each prestige needs the item back at level 100, so Prestige 5 means about level 500 per item.
